inlines.v: VENTAN'NA, VENT'ER, noun One who utters, reports or publishes. VEN'TER, noun [Latin] 1. In anatomy, the abdomen, or lower belly; formerly applied to any large cavity containing viscera, as the head, thorax and abdomen, called three venters. 2. The womb; and hence, mother. A has a son B by one venter, and a daughter C by another venter; children by different venters. 3. The belly of a muscle.
